newsitem.title: NIGER: Niger government closes university restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Niger government closes university restaurant.

text.p: The government of Niger has closed the university restaurant in the capital Niamey and other services following a sit-in by students demanding that those not on grants be allowed to eat there.
The cash-strapped West African nation's higher education ministry ordered the move on Tuesday after a day of tension over the issue.
Student protests closed the university in January 1996. It reopened in November but since January students have been threatening protests over unpaid grants and other grievances.
